locations: Art Institute of Chicago scholarly catalogue Cat.28: Monet, Stacks of Wheat (End of Day, Autumn), 1890/91, canvas, accession 1933.444, signature Claude Monet 91 lower left.

Technical Summary: subtle tonality base followed by saturated strokes; small left stack moved lower/right to upper/left; large right stack widened on left and made taller; buildings and horizon raised.
Signature: applied while pale pink and bluish-purple underlying paint still wet, as documented by technical microscopy.
